subject: Social Media
title: How Algorithms Feed Mobs
description: A 60-second lesson on How Algorithms Feed Mobs.

hook.text: A post gets rapid replies. The algorithm boosts it. More people see it. More pile on. The loop accelerates.

buildup.text: Engagement-driven algorithms treat outrage like gold. Divisive content gets 6x the engagement of calm posts.

discovery.text: Facebook's internal research called its own algorithm 'an outrage machine.' They knew—and didn't fix it.

twist.text: Reducing outrage would cut engagement by 10%. Quarterly earnings mattered more than harm reduction.

climax.text: Algorithms don't create mobs. They amplify, accelerate, and profit from them. The system rewards fury.

punchline.text: The algorithm doesn't hate you. It just profits when others do.

quiz.question: How much more engagement does divisive content get?
